blocks.text: **in case** ehtiyot chorasini bildiradi: biz hozir (oldindan) biror ish qilamiz, chunki keyin nimadir **bo'lib qolishi mumkin**. Take a jumper **in case** it gets cold — Sovuq **tushib qolsa deb**, sviter ol. O'zbekchada bu ma'noni «**-sa deb**», «**bo'lib qolsa deb**», «**... ehtimoli borligi uchun**» beradi. Muhim belgi — **deb** so'zi: biz harakatni sodir bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan voqeani ko'zlab bajaramiz, voqea bo'lmasa ham harakat baribir qilingan bo'ladi.

rows: Take an umbrella **in case** it rains.
Here's a map **in case** you get lost.
Bring a charger **in case** the battery dies.

blocks.text: in case + Present Simple (kelasi zamon ma'nosida)

in case dan keyingi gap kelajak haqida bo'lsa ham **will** ishlatilmaydi — Present Simple qo'yiladi. Bu qoida if, when, before, as soon as dagi qoida bilan bir xil (→ 25-dars; qizil kitob, 98–99-darslar): **in case** it **rains** («in case it will rain» emas). Bosh gapda esa istalgan shakl bo'lishi mumkin: buyruq (Take ...), will (I'll take ...), going to, Let's ...

items.text: Take some snacks **in case** you get hungry on the bus.
items.translation: Avtobusda qorning **ochib qolsa deb**, biror yegulik ol.

items.text: I'll give you my address **in case** you're ever in Bukhara.
items.translation: Qachondir Buxoroga **kelib qolsang deb**, manzilimni beraman.

items.text: Let's book a table **in case** the restaurant is busy tonight.
items.translation: Bugun kechqurun restoran gavjum **bo'lib qolsa deb**, stol band qilaylik.

blocks.text: in case va if — eng muhim farq

O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «-sa» bilan tarjima qilinadi, shuning uchun ular ko'p adashtiriladi. **if** — **shart**: harakat faqat voqea sodir bo'lsa bajariladi (avval voqea, keyin harakat). **in case** — **ehtiyot**: harakat voqeadan **oldin** va unga bog'liq bo'lmagan holda bajariladi (avval harakat, voqea bo'lishi ham, bo'lmasligi ham mumkin).

rows: I'll call a taxi **if** it rains. (yomg'ir yog'sa, chaqiraman)
I'll take an umbrella **in case** it rains. (hozir olaman)
Buy some milk **if** we need it. (kerak bo'lsagina ol)
Buy some milk **in case** we need it. (kerak bo'lib qolsa deb, hozir ol)
Ring me **if** you're late. (kechiksang, qo'ng'iroq qil)
Take my number **in case** you're late. (kechiksang deb, raqamni ol)

items.text: I'll take my glasses **in case** I need to read something.
items.translation: Biror narsa o'qishim **kerak bo'lib qolsa deb**, ko'zoynagimni olaman.

items.text: I'll put on my glasses **if** I need to read something.
items.translation: Biror narsa o'qishim **kerak bo'lsa**, ko'zoynagimni taqaman.

blocks.text: O'tmishda qilingan ehtiyot chorasi haqida gapirganda in case dan keyin **Past Simple** keladi: I took some cash **in case** the card **didn't work**. Bu gap o'sha paytdagi sababni tushuntiradi — nega bunday qildim. Rasmiyroq uslubda **in case ... should** ham uchraydi va voqea ehtimoli kamligini bildiradi: **in case** you **should** need help.

items.text: I phoned the hotel again **in case** they had lost my booking.
items.translation: Bronimni yo'qotib **qo'yishgan bo'lsa deb**, mehmonxonaga yana qo'ng'iroq qildim.

items.text: We packed sandwiches **in case** the café on the road was closed.
items.translation: Yo'ldagi kafe **yopiq bo'lsa deb**, buterbrod olib oldik.

blocks.text: **just in case** — «**har ehtimolga qarshi**»: gap oxirida yakka holda ham keladi. I don't think we'll need it, but I'll bring it **just in case**. Bunda «nima bo'lishi mumkin»ligi aytilmaydi — u kontekstdan tushunarli.

**in case of** + ot — «**... bo'lgan taqdirda**», «**... holatida**». Ma'nosi in case dan farq qiladi: u **if there is** ga teng, ya'ni shart bildiradi. Asosan rasmiy matnlarda uchraydi: e'lonlar, yo'riqnomalar, sug'urta shartlari. **in case of** dan keyin faqat ot keladi, gap emas.

rows: **In case of** fire, use the stairs.
The match will be cancelled **in case of** heavy rain.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: 1) «in case it **will** rain» → **in case it rains** (kelasi zamon ma'nosida ham Present). 2) «**in case of** it rains» → **in case** it rains; in case of dan keyin faqat ot: **in case of rain**. 3) Shartni in case bilan berish: «Call me **in case** you need help» — bu «yordam kerak bo'lib qolsa deb (oldindan) qo'ng'iroq qil» degan g'alati ma'no beradi; shart kerak bo'lsa — Call me **if** you need help. 4) «-sa» ni doim if deb tarjima qilish: «Kechikib qolsam deb, erta chiqdim» — bu **in case**: I left early **in case** I was late.

Tekshirish usuli: o'zbekcha tarjimaga «**deb**» qo'shib ko'ring. «Yomg'ir yog'sa **deb** soyabon olaman» — ma'no saqlansa, **in case**. «Yomg'ir yog'sa, uyda qolaman» — «deb» qo'shib bo'lmaydi, demak **if**.
Amerika ingliz tilida in case ba'zan if ma'nosida ham ishlatiladi. British English da farqni saqlang: **in case** — ehtiyot, **if** — shart.

rows: Take a coat **in case** it **gets** cold.
I took a coat **in case** it **got** cold.
I'll take a coat, **just in case**.
Call us **in case** you **should** need help.
**In case of** fire, leave the building.

examples.title: **In case** + present: before a trip
examples.description: in case + Present Simple (kelajak ma'nosida ham will yo'q): safarga tayyorgarlikda oldindan ko'rilgan ehtiyot choralari.

sentences.text: Take a warm jacket **in case** it gets cold in the mountains at night.
sentences.translation: Kechasi tog'da sovuq **tushib qolsa deb**, issiq kurtka ol.

sentences.text: I always carry a power bank **in case** my phone dies on a long journey.
sentences.translation: Uzoq yo'lda telefonimning quvvati **tugab qolsa deb**, doim powerbank olib yuraman.

sentences.text: Write down the hotel address **in case** you get lost in the old town.
sentences.translation: Eski shaharda adashib **qolsang deb**, mehmonxona manzilini yozib ol.

sentences.text: **In case** the shops are closed when we arrive, let's buy some food at the station.
sentences.translation: Yetib borganimizda do'konlar yopiq **bo'lib qolsa deb**, vokzaldan ozgina ovqat olib olaylik.

sentences.text: Madina is taking some cash **in case** the taxi drivers in Fergana don't accept cards.
sentences.translation: Farg'onadagi taksichilar karta **qabul qilmasa deb**, Madina o'zi bilan naqd pul olyapti.

sentences.text: Should I bring my passport **in case** they ask for ID at the hotel?
sentences.translation: Mehmonxonada hujjat **so'rab qolishsa deb**, pasportimni olib olaymi?

sentences.text: Pack some medicine **in case** you get a stomach ache from the street food.
sentences.translation: Ko'cha taomlaridan qorningiz **og'rib qolsa deb**, dori-darmon olib oling.

sentences.text: Download a few films before you leave **in case** there's no Wi-Fi in the cottage.
sentences.translation: Dala hovlida Wi-Fi **bo'lmasa deb**, jo'nashdan oldin bir nechta film yuklab oling.

sentences.text: We'll set off early **in case** there are long queues at passport control.
sentences.translation: Pasport nazoratida uzun navbat **bo'lib qolsa deb**, erta yo'lga chiqamiz.

sentences.text: Kate has saved her boarding pass on two devices **in case** one of them stops working.
sentences.translation: Qurilmalardan biri ishlamay **qolsa deb**, Keyt bortga chiqish talonini ikkita qurilmaga saqlab qo'ydi.

examples.title: Everyday precautions at home and at work
examples.description: Uyda va ishda oldindan qilinadigan ishlar: zaxira kalit, hujjat nusxasi, fayllarni saqlash. in case qismi gap boshida ham, oxirida ham.

sentences.text: Save your work every ten minutes **in case** the computer crashes.
sentences.translation: Kompyuter qotib **qolsa deb**, har o'n daqiqada ishingizni saqlang.

sentences.text: Our neighbour keeps a spare key to our flat **in case** we lock ourselves out.
sentences.translation: Kalitni ichkarida qoldirib **eshik ortida qolsak deb**, qo'shnimiz kvartiramizning zaxira kalitini saqlab turadi.

sentences.text: Jasur always backs up his photos **in case** something happens to his laptop.
sentences.translation: Noutbukiga biror narsa **bo'lib qolsa deb**, Jasur doim suratlarining zaxira nusxasini oladi.

sentences.text: **In case** the printer breaks down again, I've emailed the report to everyone.
sentences.translation: Printer yana buzilib **qolsa deb**, hisobotni hammaga elektron pochta orqali yubordim.

sentences.text: Let me give you my mobile number **in case** you need me at the weekend.
sentences.translation: Dam olish kunlari men **kerak bo'lib qolsam deb**, mobil raqamimni beray.

sentences.text: There's a torch in the kitchen drawer **in case** the electricity goes off.
sentences.translation: Elektr **o'chib qolsa deb**, oshxona tortmasida fonar turibdi.

sentences.text: Shall I make a copy of the contract **in case** the original gets lost?
sentences.translation: Asl nusxasi yo'qolib **qolsa deb**, shartnomadan nusxa olib qo'yaymi?

sentences.text: The nurse checks on Grandma every hour **in case** her temperature goes up again.
sentences.translation: Buvimning harorati yana **ko'tarilib qolsa deb**, hamshira har soatda uning holidan xabar oladi.

sentences.text: Could you keep the living room tidy **in case** the guests arrive early?
sentences.translation: Mehmonlar erta **kelib qolishsa deb**, mehmonxonani tartibli saqlab tura olasizmi?

sentences.text: My manager prints every presentation **in case** the projector in the meeting room doesn't work.
sentences.translation: Majlislar zalidagi proyektor **ishlamay qolsa deb**, rahbarim har bir taqdimotni chop etib qo'yadi.

examples.title: **In case** or **if**?
examples.description: if — shart: harakat faqat voqea sodir bo'lsa bajariladi. in case — ehtiyot: harakat oldindan, baribir bajariladi. Juft gaplarda farqni solishtiring.

sentences.text: I'll make some extra soup **in case** Aziz comes for dinner.
sentences.translation: Aziz kechki ovqatga **kelib qolsa deb**, ko'proq sho'rva qilaman.

sentences.text: **If** Aziz comes for dinner, I'll ask him to bring some bread.
sentences.translation: Aziz kechki ovqatga **kelsa**, undan non olib kelishini so'rayman.

sentences.text: Call the doctor **if** your temperature rises above thirty-nine.
sentences.translation: Haroratingiz o'ttiz to'qqizdan **oshsa**, shifokorga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Keep the doctor's number by the bed **in case** your temperature rises in the night.
sentences.translation: Kechasi haroratingiz **ko'tarilib qolsa deb**, shifokorning raqamini karavot yonida saqlang.

sentences.text: We'll stay at home and watch a film **if** it rains on Saturday.
sentences.translation: Shanba kuni yomg'ir **yog'sa**, uyda qolib film ko'ramiz.

sentences.text: Let's take our raincoats **in case** it rains on the way back.
sentences.translation: Qaytishda yomg'ir **yog'ib qolsa deb**, plashlarimizni olaylik.

sentences.text: **If** the bank is closed, I'll use the cash machine at the station.
sentences.translation: Bank **yopiq bo'lsa**, vokzaldagi bankomatdan foydalanaman.

sentences.text: Emma is taking extra cash **in case** the card machine at the market isn't working.
sentences.translation: Bozordagi terminal **ishlamay qolsa deb**, Emma qo'shimcha naqd pul olyapti.

sentences.text: Wake me up **if** the baby starts crying — I'll be in the next room.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq **yig'lay boshlasa**, meni uyg'ot — qo'shni xonada bo'laman.

sentences.text: I'll stay up a bit longer **in case** the baby wakes up and needs feeding.
sentences.translation: Chaqaloq uyg'onib, uni ovqatlantirish **kerak bo'lib qolsa deb**, biroz kechroq yotaman.

examples.title: Past precautions: **in case** + past simple
examples.description: O'tmishda qilingan ehtiyot chorasi: in case + Past Simple. Gap o'sha paytdagi sababni tushuntiradi.

sentences.text: I wrote down the taxi driver's number **in case** we needed him again.
sentences.translation: Yana **kerak bo'lib qolsa deb**, taksi haydovchisining raqamini yozib oldim.

sentences.text: Dilnoza took two umbrellas **in case** her friend forgot hers.
sentences.translation: Dugonasi o'z soyabonini **unutib qo'ysa deb**, Dilnoza ikkita soyabon oldi.

sentences.text: **In case** the trains were cancelled, Tom booked a coach ticket as well.
sentences.translation: Poyezdlar **bekor qilinsa deb**, Tom avtobusga ham chipta oldi.

sentences.text: We bought extra water **in case** the road through the desert was longer than expected.
sentences.translation: Cho'ldan o'tadigan yo'l kutilganidan uzunroq **chiqib qolsa deb**, qo'shimcha suv sotib oldik.

sentences.text: Why did you bring your laptop? — **In case** I had to work on the train.
sentences.translation: Noutbukingni nega olib kelding? — Poyezdda ishlashga **to'g'ri kelib qolsa deb**.

sentences.text: She printed her CV twice **in case** both interviewers wanted a copy.
sentences.translation: Suhbat o'tkazuvchilarning ikkalasiga ham nusxa **kerak bo'lsa deb**, u rezyumesini ikki nusxada chop etdi.

sentences.text: My mother had packed a whole bag of samsa **in case** anyone got hungry.
sentences.translation: Kimdir qorni **ochib qolsa deb**, onam bir sumka somsa solib qo'ygan edi.

sentences.text: Bekzod parked near the exit **in case** he had to leave the stadium early.
sentences.translation: Stadiondan erta **ketishiga to'g'ri kelsa deb**, Bekzod mashinasini chiqish yaqiniga qo'ydi.

sentences.text: The teacher repeated the instructions **in case** some students hadn't understood.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi talabalar **tushunmagan bo'lsa deb**, o'qituvchi ko'rsatmalarni takrorladi.

sentences.text: I didn't switch off my phone during the film **in case** the hospital called about my dad.
sentences.translation: Shifoxonadan dadam haqida qo'ng'iroq **qilib qolishsa deb**, kino paytida telefonimni o'chirmadim.

examples.title: **Just in case** and **in case** ... **should**
examples.description: just in case — «har ehtimolga qarshi», gap oxirida yakka ham keladi. in case ... should — rasmiyroq, voqea ehtimoli kamligini bildiradi.

sentences.text: I don't think it'll rain, but I'll take an umbrella **just in case**.
sentences.translation: Yomg'ir yog'adi deb o'ylamayman, lekin **har ehtimolga qarshi** soyabon olaman.

sentences.text: The flight isn't until noon. Let's leave at eight, **just in case**.
sentences.translation: Parvoz faqat tushda. Lekin **har ehtimolga qarshi** soat sakkizda chiqaylik.

sentences.text: **Just in case** you've forgotten, the meeting has moved to Thursday.
sentences.translation: **Unutgan bo'lsangiz deb** eslataman: yig'ilish payshanbaga ko'chirildi.

sentences.text: Sarah checked the oven twice before leaving the flat, **just in case**.
sentences.translation: Sara kvartiradan chiqishdan oldin, **har ehtimolga qarshi**, duxovkani ikki marta tekshirdi.

sentences.text: Keep the receipt **just in case** the shoes don't fit your brother.
sentences.translation: Poyabzal akangga **to'g'ri kelmasa deb**, chekni saqlab qo'y.

sentences.text: Please contact our office **in case** you **should** need any further information.
sentences.translation: Qo'shimcha ma'lumot **kerak bo'lib qolsa**, ofisimizga murojaat qiling.

sentences.text: Here is my business card **in case** you **should** have any questions later.
sentences.translation: Keyinroq biror savolingiz **tug'ilib qolsa deb**, mana tashrif qog'ozim.

sentences.text: The hotel keeps a doctor on call **in case** a guest **should** fall ill at night.
sentences.translation: Kechasi mehmonlardan biri **kasal bo'lib qolsa deb**, mehmonxonada doim navbatchi shifokor bor.

sentences.text: Have you got a spare charger with you, **just in case**?
sentences.translation: **Har ehtimolga qarshi** yoningda zaxira quvvatlagich bormi?

sentences.text: My dad writes all his passwords in a notebook, **just in case**, which isn't very safe.
sentences.translation: Dadam **har ehtimolga qarshi** barcha parollarini daftarga yozib qo'yadi, bu esa unchalik xavfsiz emas.

examples.title: **In case of** + noun: signs and instructions
examples.description: in case of + ot = «... bo'lgan taqdirda» (= if there is). Rasmiy uslub: e'lonlar, yo'riqnomalar, sug'urta shartlari.

sentences.text: **In case of** fire, do not use the lifts under any circumstances.
sentences.translation: Yong'in **chiqqan taqdirda**, hech qanday holatda liftdan foydalanmang.

sentences.text: Break the glass and press the red button **in case of** emergency.
sentences.translation: Favqulodda **vaziyatda** oynani sindiring va qizil tugmani bosing.

sentences.text: Passengers must follow the crew's instructions **in case of** an emergency landing.
sentences.translation: Favqulodda qo'nish **bo'lgan taqdirda**, yo'lovchilar ekipaj ko'rsatmalariga amal qilishi shart.

sentences.text: The concert will be moved indoors **in case of** bad weather.
sentences.translation: Ob-havo yomon **bo'lsa**, konsert yopiq binoga ko'chiriladi.

sentences.text: Our travel insurance covers the flight home **in case of** serious illness.
sentences.translation: Jiddiy kasallik **holatida** sayohat sug'urtamiz uyga qaytish parvozini qoplaydi.

sentences.text: Students get a phone number to call **in case of** problems with their accommodation.
sentences.translation: Turar joy bilan muammo **bo'lsa**, qo'ng'iroq qilish uchun talabalarga telefon raqami beriladi.

sentences.text: **In case of** delay, the airline will provide free meals and drinks.
sentences.translation: Reys **kechikkan taqdirda**, aviakompaniya bepul ovqat va ichimlik beradi.

sentences.text: Every school in Tashkent has a clear plan **in case of** an earthquake.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdagi har bir maktabda zilzila **yuz bergan taqdirda** aniq harakat rejasi bor.

sentences.text: What should we do **in case of** a power cut during the exam?
sentences.translation: Imtihon paytida elektr **o'chib qolsa**, nima qilishimiz kerak?

sentences.text: Keep this leaflet — it explains what to do **in case of** food poisoning.
sentences.translation: Bu varaqani saqlab qo'ying — unda ovqatdan **zaharlanganda** nima qilish kerakligi yozilgan.

examples.title: Dialogue: packing for a hike in Chimgan
examples.description: Ikki do'st tog'ga sayrga tayyorlanmoqda: in case, just in case, in case of va if bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Are you packing a first-aid kit **in case** someone gets hurt?
sentences.translation: — Kimdir jarohat **olib qolsa deb**, birinchi yordam qutichasini olyapsanmi?

sentences.text: — Yes, and some plasters **in case** our new boots give us blisters.
sentences.translation: — Ha, yangi botinkalar oyog'imizni **ishqalab qo'ysa deb**, plastir ham olyapman.

sentences.text: — Good idea. I'll bring an extra jumper **in case** it gets windy at the top.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Cho'qqida shamol **turib qolsa deb**, qo'shimcha sviter olaman.

sentences.text: — Should we take a paper map **in case** there's no signal up there?
sentences.translation: — U yerda aloqa **bo'lmay qolsa deb**, qog'oz xarita olaylikmi?

sentences.text: — I've downloaded one, but let's print it too, **just in case**.
sentences.translation: — Bittasini yuklab oldim, lekin **har ehtimolga qarshi** chop ham qilaylik.

sentences.text: — And what do we do **if** the weather turns bad?
sentences.translation: — Ob-havo **buzilsa**, nima qilamiz?

sentences.text: — **If** it starts raining heavily, we'll turn back immediately.
sentences.translation: — Qattiq yomg'ir **boshlansa**, darhol ortga qaytamiz.

sentences.text: — Fine. Let's also tell Bekzod our route **in case** we're late coming back.
sentences.translation: — Mayli. Qaytishda **kechikib qolsak deb**, Bekzodga yo'nalishimizni ham aytib qo'yaylik.

sentences.text: — Good thinking. The park rules say to call the rescue service **in case of** an accident.
sentences.translation: — To'g'ri o'ylading. Park qoidalariga ko'ra, baxtsiz hodisa **yuz bersa**, qutqaruv xizmatiga qo'ng'iroq qilish kerak.

sentences.text: — Right. Let's leave at six **in case** the car park fills up early.
sentences.translation: — Kelishdik. Avtoturargoh erta **to'lib qolsa deb**, soat oltida yo'lga chiqaylik.

examples.title: Mixed: **in case**, **in case of** or **if**?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ehtiyot chorasi (in case), rasmiy shart (in case of) va oddiy shart (if) murakkabroq gaplarda.

sentences.text: Many people keep a little cash at home **in case** the banks have technical problems.
sentences.translation: Banklarda texnik nosozlik **bo'lib qolsa deb**, ko'pchilik uyda ozgina naqd pul saqlaydi.

sentences.text: The company stores its data on two continents **in case** one data centre goes down.
sentences.translation: Ma'lumotlar markazlaridan biri **ishdan chiqsa deb**, kompaniya ma'lumotlarini ikki qit'ada saqlaydi.

sentences.text: **If** you feel dizzy after taking these tablets, stop immediately and call your doctor.
sentences.translation: Bu tabletkalarni ichgandan keyin boshingiz **aylansa**, darhol to'xtating va shifokoringizga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

sentences.text: Nilufar learned some basic Turkish phrases **in case** nobody at the conference spoke English.
sentences.translation: Konferensiyada hech kim ingliz tilida **gapirmasa deb**, Nilufar turkcha bir nechta oddiy iboralarni o'rganib oldi.

sentences.text: **In case of** heavy snow, the school will send a message to all parents by eight.
sentences.translation: Kuchli qor **yog'sa**, maktab soat sakkizgacha barcha ota-onalarga xabar yuboradi.

sentences.text: Don't throw away the box **in case** you need to return the headphones.
sentences.translation: Quloqchinni **qaytarishga to'g'ri kelsa deb**, qutisini tashlab yubormang.

sentences.text: James always reads the safety card on planes, **just in case**, although he flies every week.
sentences.translation: Har hafta uchsa ham, Jeyms **har ehtimolga qarshi** samolyotdagi xavfsizlik kartasini doim o'qiydi.

sentences.text: Kate has started saving part of her salary **in case** the company announces job cuts next year.
sentences.translation: Kompaniya kelasi yil qisqartirish **e'lon qilib qolsa deb**, Keyt maoshining bir qismini jamg'ara boshladi.

sentences.text: We'll cancel the picnic only **if** the forecast is really bad, not **in case** it rains a little.
sentences.translation: Piknikni faqat ob-havo ma'lumoti juda yomon **bo'lsa** bekor qilamiz, ozgina yomg'ir **yog'ib qolar deb** emas.

sentences.text: Doctors advise travellers to carry a list of their medicines **in case** they need treatment abroad.
sentences.translation: Chet elda davolanish **kerak bo'lib qolsa deb**, shifokorlar sayohatchilarga dori-darmonlari ro'yxatini olib yurishni maslahat beradi.
